​

⚡️ Senior MP: American formula won’t bring regional security

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Iranian Parliament Deputy Speaker Hamidreza Haji Babai stressed that an American formula cannot bring security to the region, stating that regional security is ensured by the region’s own countries.

Addressing the Parliament open session on Tuesday, Haji Babai referred to the meeting of the member countries of the Mecca Pact with the Foreign Minister and the Secretary of the National Security Council in Tehran on Monday.
​
Iran views the observance of good neighborliness and cooperation with neighboring and regional countries in a positive light, he added.
​
US President Donald Trump has grown desperate over the war issue; the Zionist regime’s elections are currently underway, and the US President is trying to push oil prices down while managing America’s domestic problems, he stated.
​
The Monday meeting in Tehran demonstrated which country is the region’s main player and who holds the key to regional security, he noted.
​
Every country in the region should understand that security is shaped by the region’s own countries, and experience has proven that America brings no benefit to regional security, Haji Babai said.
​
Iran’s continued management of the Strait of Hormuz and the rise in oil prices, together with Monday’s visit by neighboring countries to Iran, demonstrate Iran’s power and the desperation of the US and the wretched Zionist regime, he added.
